name: Arun Patel
bio:
Arun Patel's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricacies of internal combustion engines, fueled by watching Formula 1 races on a grainy television in his hometown. He pursued mechanical engineering, specializing in thermodynamics and fluid dynamics. After graduating, Arun honed his skills at a local automotive company before making the leap to motorsport, joining a Formula 3 team as a junior engineer.

His analytical mind and meticulous approach quickly earned him recognition. Arun believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking marginal gains through rigorous analysis and simulation. He is known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, helping drivers extract maximum performance from their machinery. Now at Inter Europol Competition, Arun is eager to use his years of experience to contribute to the team's success. His demanding nature, while sometimes challenging, stems from a deep commitment to excellence and a relentless pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a receding hairline
physical.facialHair: Short, trimmed salt and pepper beard
physical.description: Arun is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the pit lane.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking only masala chai during race weekends.
